## Ajax Autumn Series 2026

This competition is in a series with [Ajax Autumn PM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxAutumnPM2026). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Mailing List

Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

​
The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) presents **Bago Speedcubing Open 2026**.
​
* All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above.
* If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BagoSpeedcubingOpen2026#73725-payment-and-registration).
* Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating.
* Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it.
​
###### *By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*

items.information:
## This competition has Dual Rounds for 3x3! Every competitor will advance to 3x3 Round 2! Newcomers recommended!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
